laws.statement: offsets are prefix sums of effective extents
positive extents roundtrip between index and offset
measurement updates preserve untouched extents
splice preserves ordered extent concatenation
extent knowledge kind does not change effective geometry
move preserves extents under post-removal destination semantics
render range contains the visible range
measurement changes preserve the visible anchor coordinate
stale measurement generations cannot mutate layout
sequence patches preserve surviving viewport anchors
target scrolling is an explicit host command
data loading remains a collection-window request
serializable snapshots restore identical layout observations
every identity is assigned exactly once and shortest-lane placement matches the reference scan
viewport queries equal a full geometry scan and reverse flow reflects forward geometry
round-robin lane ownership is stable across measurement changes
measurement and item mutation preserve surviving anchors and reject stale generations
packed spatial queries equal a full rectangle scan
z-index and declaration order define deterministic paint order
measurement, update, and removal keep identity indexes consistent
rectangle boundaries, zero-size items, anchors, and stale generations are explicit
sparse region queries equal a full region scan
merged regions reflect exactly under reversed row and column flows
overlap and region-splitting track mutations reject atomically
row and column measurements preserve indexes, anchors, and generation
